name: Hiyama Chitose
source:
A former gravure idol.
Due to not selling well, she retired early, got married and gave birth. She is now a bold-looking mother.
The married couple is sexless, but she thinks that's normal given her physique and age.
Due to diet training with Daniel, her confidence as a woman has recovered.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc061/character.html#chitose]the official site[/url]]
